description: The story unit a child story workflow is given (pipeline.md#2.10.8). Returned by vsdd survey story and wave, by vsdd gate plan --story in the gate result's unit, by vsdd story new-fix, and in the fix_units of vsdd gate wave. The tool prints every field, empty where it has nothing.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the story's worktree.

tree.description: The root that finding paths are relative to.

base.description: The recorded commit the branch was cut from (topic:worktrees).

tests_agent.description: The agent of the story's tests stage, from its kind; empty when the kind has no tests stage.

tests_method.description: The story's resolved tests-stage method; empty when the kind has no tests stage.

impl_agent.description: The agent of the story's implement stage, from its kind.

impl_method.description: The story's resolved implement-stage method; empty when it has none.

red_gate.description: Whether the story's kind has a red gate (the story-kind row), so the gates expect a passing red record.

diff_patch.description: Path of the latest diff patch; empty before the first green gate.

review_rules.description: Path of review-rules.md; empty when the project has none.

fixes.description: For a fix story: the keys of the findings it answers.
